heading: This Afternoon
text: Variable clouds. Highs in the mid to upper 70s. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Lows from the mid 50s to lower 60s, some lower 50s far north. Winds becoming light, variable to north.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly cloudy. Slight chance of a morning shower, then becoming likely in the afternoon, near and south of Route 2, chance to the north. Highs in the low to mid 70s, mid to upper 70s far south. Winds light and variable.
